newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures stall at lower levels.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures stall at lower levels.

text.p: July 18 - Sept S&P 500 stock index futures remained sharply lower at midday but were off their lowest level of 917.50 after plunging more than 20.0 points earlier in the session. Two dealers were the largest sellers in S&Ps on the downmove with about 500 contracts each, floor traders said. Intermediate 30.0-pt trading limit is in effect in Sept S&Ps.
